mentions.title: vg30 premature bearing failure help
mentions.snippet: User reports premature main bearing failure in a Nissan VG30DETT running King XP main bearings: mains 2 and 3 failed, 1 and 4 showing wear. Cause not established in the snippet.

mentions.title: Jalopy Journal forum post on repeated King main bearing failures
mentions.snippet: A builder reports King main bearings failing repeatedly in a long-stroke build and asks whether it is bad luck or a wider problem; no pattern established in the snippet.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: poster claims King main thrust bearings made since 2024 have an out-of-spec free-spread dimension, says a machinist agreed, and suggests returning them; he also notes many people may have used them without problems.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is, King bearings are no longer an option
mentions.snippet: Thread complaining King 6-bolt DSM bearings are effectively unavailable; a seller says they are not technically discontinued but King has odd production. Availability complaint, not a defect report.
